text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while we're training for the
autumn
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
It's Narita Brian! Although, something
about her
expression seems different...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She's so close to breaking the record for
the most
G1 wins! To think a racer like
this would be born
in our generation!

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second! Where did you hear
that?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, so noisy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's training is open to the public, so
the
stands are packed with both fans
and press.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The press especially seem restless. We're
catching
more of their chatter than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, really?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks that way. When I heard that,
I
couldn't help but agree Brian has it in
the bag.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Press
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm... From what I gather, it's about the
upcoming
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll be there.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh! Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fans
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Oguriiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
C-come on... It's a little embarrassing
being called
that at school...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
W-what's happening? Are we gonna see
all the
big names together at the autumn
Tenno Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta ask them about it! Over
here, Oguri
Cap! Why did you decide to
enter?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to add the autumn Tenno
Sho to
my list of achievements.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And what about you, Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was told it's an essential race if I
want
to get
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
So you're racing in it for strength?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: In that case, I definitely won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What was it you said at the URA award

ceremony? You want a battle for the
top, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What of it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
One of my goals is to win the autumn
Tenno Sho
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow competitor and someone
also seeking
strength, I won't hand it
over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That sounded like a Oguri Cap is
officially
declaring a rivalry! Does this
spell disaster for
Brian?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to be a heated race! This
year's
autumn Tenno Sho is sure going to
be a wild one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I wasn't expecting to be so restricted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So this is the autumn Tenno Sho, huh?
choice_data_list: That just shows how much attention...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Besides this, what are the
other
races in the Senior Autumn Triple
Crown?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup and the Arima
Kinen—both are
considerably famous
races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All right then,
I'd like you to register me
for those
as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
One of my goals is to win the autumn
Tenno Sho
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow competitor and someone
also seeking
strength, I won't hand it
over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Despite being such a big player,
she still
only calls herself a competitor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Then I want to answer accordingly, no
matter
what awaits me there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll make up for today's shortcomings.
The rest is
up to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that said, Narita Brian starts
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she can't contain herself
anymore. I pull
out my stopwatch to time
her, when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey. Is it true?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is Brian really set to compete in the
Senior
Autumn Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then it might not be too late to make
the end of
the year...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I mean for myself. I sincerely wish
both of
you the best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And if everything goes well, it will be so
for all of
us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Autumn Triple Crown is set
to start with the autumn Tenno Sho. But
just around the
corner, a great
disturbance grows closer.
